# Report reference

Contract `factorymeter/v1`.

This is the layout of the JSON that `factorymeter report --format json` writes. The same layout is in [`factorymeter-v1.schema.json`](factorymeter-v1.schema.json) as a JSON Schema.

Inside this version fields are only added. A reader must ignore a field it does not know. A field is never left out: a value that does not exist is null, an empty list or an empty string.

## Report

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schema` | string | Always factorymeter/v1. One of `factorymeter/v1`. |
| `generated_at` | time | When the report was computed. |
| `tool` | Tool | The program that wrote the report. |
| `target` | string | The owner or owner/repo that was measured. Empty in a summary. |
| `summary` | boolean | True when every name, title and link was left out, so the file holds station numbers only. |
| `window` | Window | The time the report covers. |
| `coverage` | Coverage | What was loaded and what is missing. |
| `verdict` | Verdict | The one-sentence answer. |
| `stations` | list of Station | The seven stations of the line, in order. |
| `metrics` | list of Series | Every number, each with its weekly history. |
| `recommendations` | list of Recommendation | Where to invest, most valuable first. |
| `limits` | list of string | What the reader should know before trusting a number. |

## Tool

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | Always factorymeter. |
| `version` | string | The version of the program. |
| `registry_version` | string | The version of the agent signature registry used to tell agents from people. |
| `record_schema` | integer | The version of the record layout in the store the report was read from. |

## Window

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `since` | time | Start of the window the values are computed over. |
| `until` | time | End of the window. |
| `period_days` | integer | Length of one period of a history, in days. 7 unless asked otherwise. |
| `periods` | list of Period | The periods of every history, oldest first. They can reach further back than the window. |
| `previous` | Period or null | The window of the same length just before this one, which values are compared with. Null when the store does not reach that far back. |

## Period

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `from` | time | Start, inclusive. |
| `to` | time | End, exclusive. |

## Coverage

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `repos` | list of RepoCoverage | One entry per repository in the store. Empty in a summary. |
| `sources` | list of SourceCoverage | One entry per kind of record. |

## RepoCoverage

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `repo` | string | The repository, as owner/name. |
| `private` | boolean | True for a private repository. |
| `from` | time | How far back the store holds this repository. |
| `synced_at` | time | When the repository was last synced. |
| `changes` | integer | Changes in the store for this repository. |

## SourceCoverage

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | The kind of record. One of `ticket`, `change`, `ci_run`, `deploy`. |
| `source` | string | Where the records come from, such as github. Empty when nothing is connected. |
| `records` | integer | How many records of this kind the window holds. |
| `note` | string | What to know about this source, such as which environment counts as production. Empty when there is nothing to say. |

## Verdict

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `headline` | string | One sentence that names the constraint and how it is moving. |
| `constraint` | string | The id of the constraint station. Empty when too few changes merged to name one. |
| `detail` | string | One or two sentences of evidence behind the headline. |

## Station

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | The station id. One of `spec`, `code`, `ci`, `verify`, `review`, `merge`, `release`. |
| `name` | string | The station name. |
| `status` | string | Whether the station could be measured. One of `measured`, `partial`, `not_connected`. |
| `missing` | string | What to connect to measure the station fully. Empty when nothing is missing. |
| `constraint` | boolean | True for the one station named the constraint. |
| `held_share` | number or null | The station's share of the hours held on the line, between 0 and 1. Null when it was not measured or is left out of the constraint. |
| `oldest` | list of Item | The items that have stood longest in the station's queue, oldest first. Empty in a summary. |

## Item

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string | What the item is. One of `ticket`, `change`. |
| `key` | string | The name people use for it, such as owner/repo#12. |
| `url` | string | Link to it on the source. |
| `title` | string | Its title. |
| `class` | string | Who wrote it. Empty for a ticket. One of `agent`, `human`, `automation`, empty. |
| `hours` | number | How long it has stood in the queue, in hours. |

## Series

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | The metric id from the registry, such as review.wait.p50. |
| `slice` | Slice | The part of the line the series is about. |
| `unit` | string | What the values count. One of `per_week`, `hours`, `share`, `count`, `lines`. |
| `value` | number or null | The value over the window. Null when nothing was counted. |
| `n` | integer | How many items the value is drawn from. |
| `thin` | boolean | True when the value is drawn from fewer items than the metric's minimum sample. |
| `previous` | number or null | The value over the previous window. Null when the store does not reach that far back or nothing was counted. |
| `previous_n` | integer | How many items the previous value is drawn from. |
| `change` | number or null | How the value moved against the previous one. For a share it is the difference, so 0.05 is five points. For anything else it is relative, so 0.2 is 20 percent more. Null when either end is missing or the previous value is zero. |
| `trend` | string | Whether the move is good news, given the direction in which the metric gets better. Flat when the move is too small to call, unknown when either end is missing or thin. One of `better`, `worse`, `flat`, `unknown`. |
| `points` | list of Point | One value per period of the window's periods, oldest first. |

## Slice

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `class` | string | Who wrote the changes. Empty for all of them. One of `agent`, `human`, `automation`, empty. |
| `agent` | string | The id of one agent in the signature registry. Empty for all. |
| `repo` | string | One repository. Empty for all. |

## Point

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | number or null | The value in the period. Null when nothing was counted. |
| `n` | integer | How many items the value is drawn from. |

## Recommendation

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `rule` | string | The id of the rule that fired, such as review.queue-growing. Rule ids are stable. |
| `station` | string | The station the recommendation is about. |
| `title` | string | What to do, in one line. |
| `why` | string | The reasoning in a sentence or two. |
| `evidence` | list of Evidence | The numbers the rule read. |
| `hours_freed` | number or null | Hours of waiting per week that would go away if the station ran as it did in its own best four weeks of the window. Null when that cannot be sized. |
| `confidence` | string | How much data stands behind the recommendation. One of `high`, `medium`, `low`. |
| `play_url` | string | Link to the playbook page that describes the practice. Empty when there is none. |
| `items` | list of Item | The items to look at first. Empty in a summary. |

## Evidence

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `metric` | string | The metric id. |
| `slice` | Slice | The part of the line the number is about. |
| `value` | number or null | The value the rule read. |
| `versus` | number or null | The value it was compared with: the previous window, the best four weeks or another slice. Null when the rule compared with a fixed threshold. |
| `text` | string | The number in words. |
